summary: A local arts guide previewing nine music festivals and events in the city from September 2023 through January, spanning folk, jazz, country, indie, classical, urban, acoustic, experimental, holiday blues and electronic music. Each entry lists dates, venues, headline acts and extras such as workshops, food vendors and art installations. The piece frames the lineup as a celebration of local talent and community culture.
one_line: A guide to nine local music festivals from September 2023 to January, covering genres from folk and country to classical, urban and electronic.
key_facts: September Serenades takes place September 3-4 at Greenvale Park and is headlined by folk singer Eleanor Rigby and jazz ensemble Blue Note Bridges, with artisanal food stalls and craft beer vendors.
The Great Harmony Hoedown is a one-day country event on September 15th at Downtown Square, featuring John "Strumming" Harper and the debut of duo The Haystack Hearts.
IndieGroove Fest runs October 11-12 at Midtown's Convention Center, featuring Daisy Dunes and Lava Lamps, plus workshops and Q&A sessions with industry professionals.
The Autumnal Classics Series runs October 25th through November 2nd at Heritage Hall and is a yearly tradition for classical musicians.

The Autumnal Classics Series hosts the debut of the "Harold Pitman Composer's Collective," which performs contemporary compositions by local composers, and pianist Maria Consuelo playing Chopin Nocturnes.

The City Sounds Urban Music Festival is November 7-8 at the Riverfront Amphitheater, headlined by rap artist MC Zeus and soul singer Lina Ray, with graffiti artists, street dancers and discussions on music's impact on social change.
The Acoustic Campfire Evenings run November 20-22 at Whispering Pines Campground, featuring Tommy Ackles and The Whispering Willows, with campfire jams and fireside tales.
The ExperimentaLoop Festival is on December 1st at the Loop Lab space, featuring Sadie Bell and Looping Lewis, with workshops on loop stations and software.
The Holiday Jazz & Blues Bash is December 12-14 at the Grand Ballroom, led by blues guitarist BB "Lightning" King and singer Veronica Voss.
The Echoes of Tomorrow Electronic Festival is January 2-3 at the Digital Dome, featuring Neon Pulse and DJ Elektra, with interactive visual arts and futuristic lighting installations.
The article describes events happening after September 1, 2023.
